name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This gives clear visibility on all backgrounds while keeping the ring compact enough not to overwhelm small touch targets. The trade-off is slightly less space for content, but the benefit of universal visibility outweighs the loss.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring blends into the pattern. A 3px solid ring with a 1px white inner ring still risks failing on high-contrast patterned backgrounds. The real alternative is a 2px ring with a 1px white inner ring, tested against WCAG 2.2 AA on 10 patterned backgrounds.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2 at 3:1 contrast on patterned backgrounds while keeping the ring compact enough for small touch targets. The trade-off is slightly less visibility on solid backgrounds, but it guarantees usability for everyone.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-2424, worker-1559 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing on low-contrast solid backgrounds where the 1px white inner ring reduces contrast too much. A better alternative is a 3px ring with a 1px white inner ring, tested against WCAG 2.1 AAA for patterned backgrounds and WCAG 2.1 AA for solid backgrounds. Settle it by testing both on high-contrast patterned and low-contrast solid backgrounds with real users.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #ffffff outer ring. Must deliver a tested, WCAG-compliant focus indicator component by [date] owned by Ramp.
